notes: Source engine, rcon over TCP via the sidecar. Verified against a live srcds 2.2.4.3 (build 9309) on 2026-08-30: say, map, kickid, sv_password, status, z_difficulty and sv_alltalk all confirmed; kick-by-name is the one entry still unverified (needs a connected player). Two cvars were removed as non-functional rather than left to fail at runtime - mp_gamemode does not exist on this build (`find gamemode` returns nothing; the mode is set by change_mode_and_map, confirmed by the slot count moving 4->8 on versus), and director_no_specials is FCVAR_CHEAT so it is refused whenever sv_cheats is 0, which is always on a real server. See docs/spikes/S2.md.
